features: identity (name, type, role, owner, business_unit, data_classification, criticality)
tool_groups (named groups of tools for batch policy application)
cicada/v2.migration_notes: v1 policies are fully compatible with v2. New fields are additive.

upgrade_policy.strategy: Additive-only — new fields are always optional with sensible defaults. Removing or renaming fields requires a major version bump with deprecation shim.

validation_rules.unknown_version: reject with error listing available versions
validation_rules.deprecated_version: warn but accept, log deprecation notice to audit ledger
